messages:
maya: heads-up — dashboard p95/p99 numbers don't match endpoint breakdown for the last 6h. p95 overall is 220ms but top endpoints aggregate looks like ~180ms. Anyone else seeing this?
sam: saw the telemetry alert. can you paste the query you ran?
maya: pulled the 'global_percentiles' materialized view from ClickHouse. Query I used:

```
SELECT toUInt32(quantileExact(0.95)(latency_ms)) AS p95_global
FROM requests
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
```

But I noticed endpoint-level panels use quantileTDigest on sketches written at ingest.
devon: ahhh — that's the mismatch. quantileExact operates on raw rows (and is exact but expensive), quantileTDigest works on sketches and is mergeable/approximate. merging sketches vs recomputing exact can yield different tail behavior.
maya: so why is global higher? I would have thought sketch merge approximates the same.
devon: t-digest has bias at extremes depending on compression and how we shard. Also if the global job samples or has different retention of raw rows vs sketches we'll diverge. We also have to be careful about the aggregation order — aggregating per-endpoint then computing p95 is different than computing p95 over the concatenated stream unless you merge the same sketch objects.
sam: options: (1) change global dashboard to compute quantiles by merging the sketches we already ingest (preferred), (2) keep current exact approach but backfill raw rows more often (expensive), (3) show both and annotate which is used.
jules: UX: any change should be surfaced prominently. propose a small banner: "Percentile calculation changed — displaying approximate values (tdigest). Expected drift ±X% vs exact." and a tooltip explaining merge semantics. Also show sample size and sketch counts per endpoint.
maya: can we run a backfill that recomputes global p95 using merged sketches for the last 24h to sanity-check deltas?
sam: yes. ingestion team stores sketches per minute per endpoint. Example ClickHouse merge query:

```
SELECT quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(tdigest) AS p95_merge
FROM endpoint_sketches
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
```

If we expose that as the source for the global panel, numbers should align with per-endpoint panels.
ops-bot: telemetry-alert: percentile-drift detected - /v1/generate p99 increased by 18% vs prev-24h. Ticket created: #TI-4321.
jules: +1 on confidence bands and showing 'sketch sample count' in the UI. That'll reduce noisy support pings. Also add a control in the rollouts UX to pick displayed percentile source (merged-sketches | exact-backfill).
devon: technical follow-up — hdrHistogram with fixed buckets is another option if we need tighter guarantees at p99; t-digest merge behavior can be tuned (compression param). I'll prototype a mergeable hdr-style histogram as an alternative. Also note: don't assert weird monotonicity properties across aggregations — instead assert reproducibility between same-method global vs per-endpoint computations (i.e., merged-sketch global == concatenated raw rows within epsilon when both are available).
maya: thanks. timeline?
sam: I'll prioritize a merged-sketch pipeline and add a dashboard feature flag. aiming for a staged rollout: feature flag + banner tomorrow EOD, merged-sketch job within 48h. devon will open PR tonight for merge operator and tests.
maya: can we add a short release note for SRE and CS so they're not surprised by drift?
jules: will draft a sentence and drop it in #announcements.

-- end of thread
